title: Amelioration of pain and adjuvant-induced arthritis by syringic acid via modulation of behavioral parameters and inflammatory mediators i.e. TNF-alpha, Interleukins, MCP-1, NF-kB and COX-2.
authors: Saleem, Noviara; Raza, Syed Atif; Alamgeer; Khalil-Ur-Rehman, Muhammad; Anwar, Rukhsana; Ahmed, Abrar; Irfan, Hafiz Muhammad
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估丁香酸对大鼠佐剂性关节炎的抗炎作用，分子对接仅涉及小分子与炎症蛋白（非DNA），无蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Syringic acid with reported anti-inflammatory attribute was investigated in the present study to assess its anti-arthritic potential at doses of 25 mg/kg, 50 mg/kg and 100 mg/kg using adjuvant-induced arthritic rats. The rat's paw size (mm), arthritic index and behavioral parameters were observed at baseline and subsequently at seven days' interval until the completion of the study, following complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA) induction. The animals were anesthetized on 28th day and blood samples were obtained for the determination of numerous biochemical, hematological, pro-inflammatory, anti-inflammatory and oxidative biomarkers. Afterwards, the weight of lymphoid organs and radiographic, as well as histopathological examinations of the inflamed paw, were conducted. Furthermore, molecular docking was done to find out the interaction between syringic acid and Interleukins-1beta, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, Interleukins-6 (IL-6), Interleukins-4 (IL-4) and Cyclooxygenase-2 (Cox-2). Results revealed that chronic syringic acid administration significantly reduced the paw size, arthritic index, and showed improvement in behavioral parameters with retrieval of altered hematological and biochemical parameters. Treatment with syringic acid also exhibited substantial recovery from oxidative stress markers and lymphoid organ weight was retrieved. Upon quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) examination, syringic acid significantly reduced the mRNA expression of tumor necrosis factor-alpha and all the other inflammatory cytokines while enhancing the mRNA expression of anti-inflammatory cytokines. Decreased serum concentration of PGE2 was noted with syringic acid as determined by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Histopathological analysis and radiographs further confirmed the findings. Molecular docking studies showed good interaction between syringic acid and IL-1beta, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, IL-6, IL-4 and COX-2 when compared against standard.
abstract_zh: 本研究以具有抗炎活性的丁香酸为研究对象，评估其在佐剂诱导的关节炎大鼠模型中，于25 mg/kg、50 mg/kg和100 mg/kg剂量下的抗关节炎潜力。在完全弗氏佐剂（CFA）诱导后，于基线和随后每隔七天观察大鼠爪大小（mm）、关节炎指数和行为学参数，直至研究结束。第28天时，动物被麻醉，采集血样以测定多种生化、血液学、促炎、抗炎及氧化应激生物标志物。随后，进行淋巴器官称重、放射学检查及炎症爪的组织病理学检查。此外，通过分子对接研究丁香酸与白细胞介素-1β、肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、白细胞介素-4（IL-4）及环氧化酶-2（COX-2）之间的相互作用。结果显示，长期给予丁香酸显著减小了爪大小和关节炎指数，改善了行为学参数，并恢复了异常的血液学和生化参数。丁香酸治疗还显著缓解了氧化应激标志物，并恢复了淋巴器官重量。通过定量实时聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）检测，丁香酸显著降低了肿瘤坏死因子-α及其他炎症细胞因子的mRNA表达，同时增强了抗炎细胞因子的mRNA表达。酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）显示，丁香酸降低了血清中PGE2浓度。组织病理学分析和放射学检查进一步证实了上述发现。分子对接研究表明，与标准品相比，丁香酸与IL-1β、肿瘤坏死因子-α、IL-6、IL-4及COX-2具有良好的相互作用。
